tha-ap428:1.1: samattaṃ. [423. Ghatamaṇḍadāyaka.] Sucintitaṃ bhagavantaṃ lokajeṭṭhaṃ narāsabhaṃ / upaviṭṭhaṃ mahāraññaṃ vātābādhena pīḷitaṃ /
tha-ap428:2.1: disvā cittaṃ pasādetvā ghatamaṇḍaṃ upānayiṃ. // // Katattā ācitattā ca GaṅgāBhāgīrasī 'va 'yaṃ /
tha-ap428:3.1: mahāsamuddā cattāro ghataṃ sampajjare mama. // // Ayañ ca paṭhavī ghorā appamāṇā asaṅkhiyā /
tha-ap428:4.1: mama saṅkappam aññāya bhavate madhusakkarā. // // Cātuddīpā ime rukkhā pādapā dharaṇīruhā /
tha-ap428:5.1: mama saṅkappam aññāya kapparukkhā bhavanti te. // // Paññāsakkhattuṃ devindo devarajjam akārayiṃ /
tha-ap428:6.1: ekapaññāsakkhattuñ ca cakkavatti ahos' ahaṃ / padesarajjaṃ vipulaṃ gaṇanāto asaṅkhiyaṃ. // //
tha-ap428:7.1: Catunavute ito kappe yaṃ dānam adadiṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi ghatamaṇḍass' idaṃ phalaṃ.
tha-ap428:11.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ghatamaṇḍadāyako th. i. g. a-ti.
